evidence_levels.working: Device capture or protocol tested; see limits.
evidence_levels.advertised: Installed plugin exposes a control; image effect and sensor-mode support unverified.
evidence_levels.native_abi: Exported native code or binary disassembly identifies a route; struct layouts/lifecycle need work.

working: Independent raw sensor capture and Codec2 H.265 at 1280x720 around 30 fps
Stereo AAC-LC at 48 kHz from internal PulseAudio regular0
SRT caller transport with web start/stop and native camera restoration
Native wireless mic create/get_capability/get_status/destroy: rc=0; two TX connection flags both 0

options.options: Auto/manual shutter; advertised ISO 100–51200; compensation -24..24 steps; 50/60 Hz/auto anti-flicker; WB presets/lock/manual temperature or RGB gains.
options.boundary: The plugin says control-mode=auto disables manual capture parameters. Validate each setting together with control-mode. Manual WB is a vendor structure needing field verification. Exposure steps are not assumed to equal EV.

options.options: Contrast 1–10, saturation 0–10, sharpness 0–6, NR off/fast/hq, dynamic-range compression on/off.
options.boundary: Test the actual image effect and latency on AC204; metadata alone is not proof.

options.options: EIS, distortion/chromatic correction, sensor-coordinate zoom rectangle.
options.boundary: EIS has IMU/time-delay inputs; do not equate one boolean with full RockSteady/Horizon modes. Zoom needs actual active sensor bounds. The pad crop property is documented only for JPEG/YUY2, not the NV12 stream currently used.

options.options: Live target bitrate and IDR interval changes; CBR/VBR/CQ presets; keyframe requests; cyclic refresh under CBR; rotation and static quality-priority regions.
options.boundary: The plugin marks target-bitrate/idr-interval mutable in PLAYING, but most other settings require NULL/READY. Hardware reactions to runtime changes have not been tested.

options.options: 10-bit frame formats, HDR and neural low-light paths are advertised.
options.boundary: No verified D-Log mode, HDR transfer function, Main10 negotiation, 4K/fps matrix, or acceptable processing latency yet. Shared APIs may include capabilities unsupported by this model.

options.options: Binary diagnostics name wind-noise reduction (including enhanced NN mode), ALC, AGC, noise controls, focus/zoom-aware processing and sample-level calculation. Native AAC uses the aacEnc* API in libAACenc.so.
options.boundary: Current internal audio is PulseAudio PCM converted to stereo and encoded with avenc_aac. It does not reuse DJI APU processing. APU parameter structs, buffer ownership, model loading and standalone lifetime must be decoded before integration.

options.feature: DJI wireless mic dashboard and controls
options.options: Two-transmitter connection state; service code also contains battery/charging, RSSI, per-TX sample-level calculations, gain bounds/steps, mute, low/high cut, denoise, channel mapping, transmitter backup recording and auto-record.
options.boundary: Only native read-only capability/status lifecycle and two disconnected TX flags have been verified. Battery/RSSI/level fields and notification masks need full ABI mapping; setters and live wireless capture need connected hardware. Do not guess mic-specific gain limits.

options.options: RTT, retransmits, packet loss/drop counts, sender queue occupancy, sent bytes; Linux battery and thermal sensors; feed live encoder bitrate and keyframe controls.
options.boundary: SRT statistics API is available; only sent-byte reporting is currently integrated. Thermal sensor selection and a stable adaptation policy need validation. Do not infer end-to-end playback or lip-sync solely from send counters.

options.options: Candidate capture-setting telemetry, face ROI data and smart-track mode.
options.boundary: Android/Qualcomm metadata layouts, vendor tags and model-specific support need mapping. Missing IR/crop/multicam tags were logged even though generic properties exist; avoid exposing every shared-library export as a working AC204 feature.

sync.interpretation: Timestamp alignment only. Physical lip-sync, long-term drift and DJI wireless buffering need an audible/visible reference test. Receiver shutdown tail truncation is excluded from drift conclusions.
